claims: Transfuse packed red blood cells for symptomatic anemia with hemoglobin nadir 7.7 g/dL and hematocrit 23.6%.
Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate FiO2 to maintain SpO2 92-96%.
Monitor serum lactate every 4-6 hours until trend is downward.
Obtain daily complete blood count and coagulation panel.
Assess and manage moderate pain with multimodal analgesia, avoiding oversedation.
Maintain glycemic control with insulin infusion and hourly point-of-care glucose checks.
Continue chest physiotherapy, incentive spirometry, and cough/deep breathing exercises.
Perform oral care with chlorhexidine and subglottic suctioning per ventilator-associated pneumonia prevention protocol.
Replete electrolytes as needed, including potassium and magnesium, and monitor levels.
Maintain temporary pacemaker settings and monitor rhythm and capture thresholds.
